prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic fine-dining scene in a warm modern kitchen at blue hour: an Asian male chef in a dark apron stands on the left side of the frame, partially cropped, concentrating as he uses tweezers and chopsticks to place tiny herb garnishes on an elegant plated dish. The dish sits centered on a large dark stone kitchen island in a shallow wide ceramic bowl, featuring a glossy seared fish fillet with golden char marks, small yellow vegetable batons, red and green accents, edible flowers, shiso-like leaves, and a small mound of black rice or caviar-like garnish. The kitchen has dark wood cabinetry, black stone backsplash, open shelves with bowls and plates, hanging towels, cooking utensils, bottles, and warm under-cabinet lighting. On the right, include a large panoramic window showing a twilight coastal forest cliff and deep blue ocean/sky outside, with three visible black pendant lights glowing warmly near the window. Use dramatic cinematic lighting: amber interior practical lights contrasting with cool blue dusk outside, soft shadows, realistic reflections on the countertop, shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, rich textures, natural skin detail, and an artful editorial food-photography composition. No text, no watermark, no extra people.
